title: Albanese Likens Israel’s Killing of Gaza Children to Nazi Practices
text:
IQNA – A United Nations official compared Israel’s killing of thousands of children in the Gaza Strip to the practices of the Nazis during the Holocaust.

Francesca Albanese, the UN special rapporteur on the situation of human rights in the occupied Palestinian territories, on Saturday compared Israel’s killing of thousands of children in the Gaza Strip to the practices of the Nazis during the Holocaust.

Albanese made the remarks in a post on X in response to comments by Israeli model Saray Givati during an interview with the Hebrew-language channel i24News.

In the interview, Givati said: “Is it possible that I do not feel sad for every child who cries in the world? I am sad. But I also understand that if we do not act, that child will grow up to become a terrorist.”

Responding to the comments, Albanese wrote: “(The children will grow up.) This was also the argument used by Nazi officials during the Nuremberg trials to justify why they killed children during the Holocaust.”

Throughout the Gaza war, Albanese has taken strong positions in support of Palestinians and against what she describes as Israeli crimes. Her reports and statements regarding the conflict have drawn significant criticism and political pressure.

In July 2025, the United States imposed sanctions on Albanese, stating that the move was linked to her efforts to encourage the International Criminal Court to pursue action against American and Israeli officials, companies and executives. Washington had previously called on UN Secretary-General António Guterres to dismiss her, accusing her of antisemitism.

The Gaza Government Media Office announced on Aug. 24 that more than 21,500 children had been martyred in the territory since the outbreak of the war in October 2023.

According to the report, Israel’s military campaign in Gaza has resulted in tens of thousands of Palestinian casualties, most of them women and children.

Source: Anadolu
